body.ruleText:
rule dac_gh_0013 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Org audit log streaming disabled or removed - audit_log_streaming.destroy / update disable"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0013"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1685.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    (($e.metadata.product_event_type = "audit_log_streaming.destroy" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "audit_log_streaming.update" nocase) or $e.metadata.product_event_type = /^business\.audit_log_streaming\./ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
